Visitor replaces subscript with custom template

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_subscript(self, ctx, text):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": f'~{text}~'}
    html = "<p>H<sub>2</sub>O is water.</p>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
